name: tusten-framework
description: tusten — fullstack React framework on React 19 + Fastify + Vite
author: yar.tema

scripts.publish:alpha: pnpm --filter @tusten/core build && cd packages/tusten && npm publish --tag alpha --access public && cd ../.. && npm dist-tag add @tusten/core@0.2.0-beta.0 alpha && npm dist-tag add @tusten/core@0.2.0-beta.0 latest
scripts.publish:beta: pnpm --filter @tusten/core build && cd packages/tusten && npm publish --tag beta --access public && cd ../.. && npm dist-tag add @tusten/core@0.2.0-beta.0 beta && npm dist-tag add @tusten/core@0.2.0-beta.0 latest
scripts.publish:latest: pnpm --filter @tusten/core build && cd packages/tusten && npm publish --tag latest --access public
scripts.version:alpha: pnpm --filter tusten exec npm version prerelease --preid=alpha
scripts.version:patch: pnpm --filter tusten exec npm version patch
scripts.version:minor: pnpm --filter tusten exec npm version minor
scripts.version:major: pnpm --filter tusten exec npm version major
